In conclusion, reading not only enriches our mind but also shapes our character, and it is truly a lifelong treasure."},{"id":"et3","title":"Should We Study Abroad?","cn":"以“大学生是否应该出国留学”为题，写一篇 150 词左右的短文，表明你的观点。","en":"Write an essay of about 150 words on whether college students should study abroad, presenting your own view.","keywords":"study abroad; culture; independence; cost; choice","wordGoal":150,"sample":"Whether to study abroad has become a heated topic among college students. Yet students should also consider their own goals and prepare themselves mentally before leaving. In fact, every small action counts: saving water and electricity, using public transport, and refusing disposable plastic bags. If everyone makes a little effort every day, the combined power will be enormous. Without face-to-face communication, some students may feel isolated, and those who lack self-discipline may easily fall behind. From my perspective, online learning is a powerful tool, but it requires strong self-management. The key is to set clear goals, make a study plan, and stick to it. Moreover, friendship teaches us to trust and to be honest, which are important qualities for our whole life. Of course, maintaining a friendship requires effort from both sides: we should be sincere, considerate, and willing to offer help whenever needed. In a word, a life without friendship is like a garden without sunshine.
